title: Objective-C methods and properties
summary: Renaming an Objective-C method or property is refused, with the reason
prose:
A method's selector names every method its messages may reach, and a
property its accessors and the instance variable it synthesizes; an
instance variable a property synthesizes has no declaration to rename.

prepare_rename.error: `_name` has no declaration in the index to rename
renaming the Objective-C method `draw` is not supported: every method its messages may reach would have to change with it
renaming the Objective-C property `x` is not supported: its accessors and the instance variable it synthesizes would have to change with it
renaming the Objective-C method `setX:y:` is not supported: every method its messages may reach would have to change with it
